sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(hb) / COUNT(*), 4) AS cart_item_buy_rate FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, MAX(behavior_type = 'buy') AS hb FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id HAVING MAX(behavior_type = 'cart') = 1) AS t LIMIT 1000

WITH combo AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MAX(behavior_type = 'fav') AS has_fav, MAX(behavior_type = 'buy') AS has_buy FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('fav', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_fav = 1 AND has_buy = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN has_fav = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS fav_to_buy_rate FROM combo LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 4) AS pay_rate FROM ub LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN buy_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS repurchase_user_rate FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS buy_cnt FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY user_id) AS t LIMIT 1000
WITH buy_cnt AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS buyer_cnt, ROUND(AVG(cnt), 4) AS avg_buy_per_buyer FROM buy_cnt LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') / SUM(behavior_type = 'pv'), 4) AS pv_to_buy_rate FROM ub LIMIT 1000

SELECT d, SUM(behavior_type = 'pv') AS pv_cnt, SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') AS buy_cnt, ROUND(SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') / SUM(behavior_type = 'pv'), 4) AS buy_pv_rate FROM ub GROUP BY d ORDER BY d LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT b.user_id IS NULL THEN a.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id), 4) AS retention_rate_3d FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-27') AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-30') AS b ON a.user_id = b.user_id LIMIT 1000

WITH d0 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-30'), d1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-12-01') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(d1.user_id) / COUNT(*), 4) AS next_day_retention FROM d0 LEFT JOIN d1 ON d0.user_id = d1.user_id LIMIT 1000

WITH first_cart_buy AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN ts END) AS cart_ts, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN ts END) AS buy_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG((buy_ts - cart_ts) / 3600), 4) AS avg_hours_cart_to_buy FROM first_cart_buy WHERE NOT cart_ts IS NULL AND NOT buy_ts IS NULL AND buy_ts > cart_ts LIMIT 1000
